description: Used to show a list of steps in a process.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the steps element.

properties.name: interactive
properties.description: If true, steps will be rendered as buttons and emit `stepClick` when activated.

events.name: stepClick
events.description: Emitted with the 0-based step index when a step is activated and `interactive` is true.
